name: @ausm/device-macos-clipboard-monitor
description: macOS clipboard activity monitor — reports CopyPasteEvent when clipboard content changes

scripts.build:swift: cd swift && swift build -c release --arch arm64 --arch x86_64 && mkdir -p ../build && cp "$(swift build -c release --arch arm64 --arch x86_64 --show-bin-path)/ClipboardHelper" ../build/clipboard-helper && codesign --force --sign "${SIGN_IDENTITY:--}" --identifier "com.ausm.clipboard-helper" ../build/clipboard-helper
scripts.build: npm run build:swift && npm run build:ts
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && cd swift && swift package clean
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build

author: Timeless
